events.title: International Day of Human Space Flight
events.summary: Greetings, Captains!Today we celebrate the International Day of Human Space Flight - the day humanity first reached beyond Earth and stepped into space. Moments like this remind us why we explore, build, and dream about the unknown. While working on Stellar Freight: Endless Horizon, we often think about that same feeling when there’s nothing but stars ahead, and every journey is a step into the unknown.
